title: Double Glass Shelf 22-Inch Wall-Mounted W/ Gallery Rail, Solid Brass | Polished Brass | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Organize toiletries where you need them—this wall-mounted double glass shelf keeps bottles and daily bathroom essentials off the counter while staying easy to reach in Polished Brass, which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic bathroom fixtures. This glass shelf works as a bathroom shelf and wall shelf, with a gallery rail designed to keep your items in place.

Highlights:
- Polished Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Coordinates with other Waverly Place pieces for a timeless, unified look
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Strong, coordinating hardware—solid brass construction with concealed screw mounting for a clean look
- Designed to match—part of the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place pieces and transitional bath accessories / transitional bathroom hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: wall-mounted glass shelf (bathroom shelf / wall shelf)
- Shelf glass dimensions: 22 x 5 Inches
- Overall dimensions: 22 in L x 5 in projection x 8 in H
- Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8-Inch), tempered
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Mounting: wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging; concealed screw mounting
- Assembly required: false
- Includes: glass shelf and all installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4"
